title.narrative: Strengthening the vulnerable young by better and inclusive sport and youth infrastructure

description.narrative: The overall objective of the Action is to improve the social cohesion of Syrian under Temporary Protection (SuTP) youth with the Turkish society. The specific objectives of the Action are to: provide additional infrastructure capacities, improve the implementation capacity of the MoYS/PIU, and to increase the awareness for the Action as well as Turkish Youth and Sport programmes and their value for the social cohesion.
